stages.handoff:
The scan stops because [parseInstalledPackagesLine](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:577) returns a `SOURCERPM` parse error before constructing the binary package. [parseInstalledPackages](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:504) then aborts the entire package loop. [splitFileName](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:690) requires the canonical dotted architecture suffix; for `1:bar-9-123a.src.rpm`, it also leaves `1:` in the source name.

The fix should append the filename error to `o.warns`, return the binary package with a nil source package, and strip a filename epoch from the parsed source name while preserving `1:9` and `1:9-123a` as the binary and source versions. The [repoquery parser](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:632) duplicates the same error path. Existing tests cover an epoch in the separate RPM field, but neither reported filename case.

I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). The assigned fault-localization scope prohibited source and test edits, so the issue remains unfixed.

Updated the RPM parsers so an unparseable `SOURCERPM` adds a warning while the binary package remains available and the scan continues. Source filenames with a numeric epoch now produce the correct source name; the binary and source versions retain the epoch.

Added regression tests for both parser paths and scan continuation. Targeted scanner tests and `git diff --check` passed.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [splitFileName](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:692) removes a numeric epoch from the source filename but does not preserve it in the returned version. Both installed-package parsers then use the binary epoch field for `SrcPackage.Version`. For `bar 0 9 123a ia64 1:bar-9-123a.src.rpm`, the source version becomes `9-123a` instead of `1:9-123a`. Preserve the filename epoch for the source version without duplicating it when the epochs match. The existing epoch tests cover only matching values.

**Tests executed:**

- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./scanner -run 'Test_redhatBase_(sourceRPMFilename|parseInstalledPackagesContinuesAfterSourceFilenameWarning|parseInstalledPackagesLine|parseInstalledPackagesLineFromRepoquery)$' -count=1` — passed.
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./scanner -count=1` — passed.

TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none. I recorded the review in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). No project code was changed during this independent review.

Fixed the RPM parsing issue. Nonstandard source filenames now produce a warning while the scan retains the binary package. Source filenames with an epoch now preserve that epoch in the source version, even when the binary epoch differs.

The targeted tests and full `./scanner` test suite passed. `TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none.`
